What the results say

Overview

  • A 2PL model with 1 dimension was fitted to 600 respondents and 32 items (EM estimation).
  • The estimation converged normally.

Model fit

  • Overall model fit is close: M2 = 683.96, df = 464, RMSEA = 0.028, CFI = 0.953, SRMSR = 0.045.
  • The chi-square test is significant, but with large samples this is common; the RMSEA indicates the misfit is small in practical terms.

Reliability

  • Marginal reliability is 0.84 (good).

Targeting

  • The average item location is -0.01 and the average person score is -0.00, so the test is well targeted for this group.
  • Measurement is most precise around theta = -1.20 (information = 7.19, SE = 0.37).

Items

  • Low discrimination: Item.12 (a = 0.16), Item.30 (a = 0.39), Item.32 (a = 0.13). These items barely separate high and low scorers; review the key and wording.
  • Extreme location: Item.9 (b = -4.04), Item.11 (b = -3.03), Item.21 (b = -4.15), Item.32 (b = 12.75). These items are far too easy or too hard for most respondents.
  • Low item-total correlation: Item.9 (r = 0.13), Item.11 (r = 0.16), Item.12 (r = 0.08), Item.21 (r = 0.14), Item.30 (r = 0.16), Item.32 (r = 0.04). These items relate weakly to the rest of the test.
  • Misfit: Item.22 (S-X2 p = .004), Item.25 (S-X2 p < .001). The model does not describe responses to these items well (alpha = 0.01); inspect them with gg_empirical() or item_card().

Local dependence

  • No item pairs show signs of local dependence (Q3).

Person fit

  • 3.0% of respondents have unusual response patterns (Zh < -1.96), which is within what chance alone would produce.
